cdcBridge.shortDescription: Capstone CDC bridge from FoundationDB to Apache Kafka with recovery fixes, Prometheus observability, daemon runner, and CI checks.
cdcBridge.challenge: Keep CDC delivery correct under failure: cursor checkpoints, partition-key ordering, and retriable Kafka commits.
cdcBridge.approach: Merged recovery fixes, unit and live partition tests, /healthz /readyz /metrics on :9102, and a poll-produce-ack daemon with graceful shutdown.
cdcBridge.result: Hardened team bridge with telemetry CI, audit logs, and documented consume/ack error handling.

textilesFlow.shortDescription: Family textile-mill ERP (web, Android, Smart TV) for production tracking, GST billing, accounting, and live loom telemetry.
textilesFlow.challenge: Support a real Surat weaving mill across platforms while keeping staging isolated from the customer portal.
textilesFlow.approach: Flutter + Provider client, Node.js/MySQL REST API, GitHub Actions deploy to textilesflowerp.saspara.com staging, ESP32-S3 Modbus IoT path.
textilesFlow.result: Production-used product with a personal staging environment and live machine dashboards.

jwksServer.shortDescription: FastAPI/SQLite JWKS server issuing RS256 JWTs with encrypted keys, Argon2 auth, logging, and per-IP rate limits.
jwksServer.challenge: Coursework auth service with key rotation, secure storage, and abuse resistance.
jwksServer.approach: AES-256-CBC private-key encryption, Argon2 hashing, registration, request logging, 10 req/s per IP, pytest coverage.
jwksServer.result: Verified token flows, expired keys, duplicates, encrypted storage, and rate limiting in tests.

swifdock.shortDescription: Native macOS container runtime using Swift, providing lightweight containerization without Docker Desktop dependency.
swifdock.challenge: Building a container runtime from scratch on macOS without relying on heavy external dependencies like Docker Desktop.
swifdock.approach: Implemented container lifecycle management with native macOS process isolation and designed a SwiftUI interface for monitoring.
swifdock.result: A lightweight, secure container solution integrated with macOS security frameworks.
